name: EOD 2026-06-12
body:
> Eod · 2026-06-12

Friday. New tooling connected (Higgsfield, NameHero SSH), first look at Prestige, and a big Alphalete blog image and SEO pass.

# Internal tooling
- Connected [Higgsfield](lib:brain-higgsfield) via MCP (Scott's Plus account). About 30 credits used, 926 remaining.
- Rebuilt the Alphalete featured-image template (1400x730, navy bar, orange chevron, lion logo, Oswald titles) as a repeatable compositor.
- Set up `ssh namehero` access to node614. The account hosts about 25 domains. See [NameHero Hosting](lib:brain-namehero-hosting).

# Prestige Plumbing
See [Prestige Plumbing (Hub)](lib:brain-prestige-plumbing-hub).
- Rundown of prestigeplumbingsc.com: new static HTML site deployed June 11 for Bluffton and Hilton Head SC. 23 sitemap pages (7 services, 6 service areas, 3 blog posts), 19 MB, no WordPress.
- Ships `llms.txt` and a `pricing.md` with flat-rate pricing, built for AI-search readability.
- Editing workflow set: changes go through SSH (read, prepare edit, approve, publish).

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Branded featured images set for all 12 posts missing one; all 20 posts now on template. Topical inline images added with keyphrase alt text.
- Metas rewritten on 18 posts (101 to 135 characters), 6 long titles shortened, 2 cannibalizing keyphrases split, 7 keyphrase/title mismatches fixed, CIPP post retargeted to "pipe bursting".
- Full green passes on 13 posts (outbound links to EPA and Wikipedia only, density, subheadings, readability).
- Converted all posts to the approved Elementor widget format. Finding: Yoast cannot read Elementor heading widgets, so headings are embedded as real H2/H3 in text widgets and the FAQ accordion goes last.
- Site-wide blog CSS: H1 raised to 42px, Related Posts readable and reduced to 3 cards, badge restyled.
- Applied the Boone FAQ background design to the Black Forest page.
- All 18 posts published and live. Re-submitted `sitemap_index.xml` (June 11 submission stuck on "Couldn't fetch") and `post-sitemap.xml`. Requested indexing on 13 new posts.

# Follow-ups
- Alphalete: confirm sitemap rows flip to Success in 2 to 3 days; request indexing for the 4 June 3 posts and 2 older posts if still unindexed; fill the Indexed column in the tracker. See [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker).
